101XP Summer Sale 2024
notes.content:
What could be better than many awesome discounts and a hot announcement of our new upcoming project? We are excited to unveil the launch of our own Summer Sale on Steam! Only until August 2, purchase all 101XP games at the best of prices!

Walk the path from birth until true death in the harsh world of the critically acclaimed narrative-driven RPG—[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante[/url]! Be prepared to make difficult choices and answer for your fateful decisions that lead to irreversible consequences.

Get immersed in the retro-futuristic world of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1596730/Dynopunk/]Dynopunk[/url], where the main character, Chris the T. rex, runs a repair shop and pursues his life’s dream, all set to a nostalgic Lo-Fi soundtrack!

Try on the mayor’s suit in the acute social visual novel [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146600/For_the_People/]For the People[/url], where you will sort out your citizens' appeals and uncover political conspiracies.

Or maybe you are into thrilling and atmospheric adventures? Then why not go on a journey through the world of nightmares and grim fairy stories in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1307690/The_Darkest_Tales/]The Darkest Tales[/url], or search the ruins of post-apocalyptic Japan as a cyber samurai in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294880/Blind_Fate_Edo_no_Yami/]Blind Fate: Edo no Yami[/url]?

Or perhaps you are looking to set aside all the philosophy and dramatic storytelling to simply enjoy the fast-paced gameplay of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488510/FatalZone/]FatalZone [/url]and annihilate hordes of abominable undead?

And if you feel like acquiring several games at once—or it just so happens that you already have some of them and are looking to complete your collection—then our lucrative bundle offers will make such a purchase even more cost-effective!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/101xp/sale/101XPpublishersale2024][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/0f2797f02b08c9e70b1232325c353d53bb84ec73.jpg[/img][/url]

There is also another grand development to report—we have literally just announced a new title in the beloved Life and Suffering universe!

The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian is a narrative-driven RPG that takes place on the pages of a book, where you will become not just a hero but the heir to the throne of the Blessed Arknian Empire—the seat of power in the world ruled by real and merciless gods. A new life-long journey awaits, full of difficult moral dilemmas, palace intrigue, the search for answers to the mysteries of creation, and heavy choices with far-reaching consequences not only for yourself but your entire Imperial domain.

Wishlist The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936290/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Prince_Jerian/

Follow us on social media and be the first to learn all the latest news:

notes.title: The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian — a new narrative RPG from Schisma Games
notes.content:
It is our pleasure to announce a new narrative roleplay adventure from the minds behind [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante[/url]!

The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian is a narrative roleplaying game that casts the player as the heir to the Blessed Arknian Empire, who must carve out a destiny for his nation. The world is grim, and the gods are eager to punish anyone who breaks their commandments. People live preordained lives, their fates sealed the moment they are born. It is up to the player to decide what kind of leader they will be: uphold the established order, or build a new kind of future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936290/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Prince_Jerian/

You, Prince Jerian of House Tempest, must embark on a lifelong journey. It starts in your childhood, blissfully ignorant of your destiny, and continues into maturity as you take up a role you have been primed for since birth: emperor. As crown prince, you must not only understand your country and its culture, but also make many difficult choices that affect the fragile balance of powers in the Empire, and inside yourself. If you go where political circumstance and family obligations guide you, you risk losing yourself in the chaos. Can you keep yourself whole, or will you shatter?

Check out the trailer, which will give you some first impressions about the upcoming game!

[previewyoutube=LsJb0TVRytc;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition, to celebrate the official announcement of the game, we are releasing a special video address from the development team at Schisma Games, in which they will pull back the veil of mystery shrouding the contents of their upcoming title. Come watch!

[previewyoutube=RdUQLk17Vqo;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is currently in development. Wishlist The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian now and subscribe to our newsletter to never miss an update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/e187dfde67bda82ee5d3133de0a985083203b26e.gif[/img]

Join our bustling [url=https://discord.gg/YWRm476CVE]Discord community[/url], the best place to make the wait for the new game a bit more enjoyable. Any questions you have, you can ask there. Discuss the game world with like-minded players, share your ideas and suggestions, and be among the first to hear any news about the game!

notes.title: Dynopunk Characters and Their Prototypes
notes.content:
We have decided to prepare an article that will not only be interesting, but also educational, as it will tell you what dinosaur species the developers were inspired by when coming up with the characters for their game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/84928bc3bc552b999e32330acc779f8682e4b993.jpg[/img]
Our ambitious but starry-eyed protagonist. He knows what he wants, but what he wants is not always pragmatic, so, suffice to say, his life has its many ups and downs. The main things Chris needs to learn is self-confidence as well as having a more realistic outlook on the world around him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/a956d8c6f9a46502e07a32a7d614159bf40b0a70.jpg[/img]
Chris's best friend from college who prefers to take it easy and cruise through life in stress-free mode, which often lands him in trouble. While some wonder how he manages to avoid worrying about anything at all, this lax attitude sometimes prevents Justin from finding common ground with more seriously-inclined dinosaurs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/e956a7a172e50691713e9d6c717a4dcf7801d7d3.jpg[/img]
Serious, bold, and determined, Dyss is an embodiment of a true biker's free spirit. On the other hand, she often lacks diplomatic skills and flexibility when talking to others, all because of her hot-tempered nature and aversion to chit-chat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/9ae07efcf27590c339d1e9ce066c45758fe99070.jpg[/img]
A responsible police officer with rich life experience and a keen sense of justice. Due to the nature of his work, Marcus often has to deal with the fear of losing his family or leaving them alone when they need him the most.
Strict with himself and others, especially in matters of morality, he respects straightforward and no-nonsense dinos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/b7eba3c5b678eea78bc8ef1d1ca3216cfe41a302.jpg[/img]
A girl from a troubled family whose motto is: "My life is a total mess, so why should I care?" Hates being lectured or told what to do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/78e28a110377912cfd7a854d42256454cf0da632.jpg[/img]
A bully with the habit of solving all problems through brute force. Unaccustomed to racking his brain before taking action, Bon hates "smart guys" and sarcasm, especially when the former use the latter against him, as it makes him feel really stupid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/4edb5d55954299a94f44010fb36fe8d7562984ed.jpg[/img]
A former classmate of Chris and a top manager at the ZaurTech company, he is not actually tech-savvy at all, but likes giving orders and knows how to make a good impression on his superiors.
Roy is not overly concerned with issues of morality, allowing him to easily take advantage of others. He is also not shy about making dirty jokes or employing sarcasm to offend someone else's sensibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/804476692d166093c2abe2df8045090b735fa75a.jpg[/img]
A fast-talking ZaurTech employee that values science above everything else. Always tries to explain phenomena from a scientific point of view, especially love and affection, for which she typically does not care much.
Sye also believes that primates may someday evolve into more complex and highly organized creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/9e0ba3ed40329c185231a480cbd32f8bb161a3a5.jpg[/img]
A charismatic dinosaur going against the system, he expresses his protest in the form of songs. Sid's image combines elements of glam rock and 80s heavy metal, but even still, he is no stranger to romance and knows how to win over the hearts of girls with just the right sort of lyrics. Likes people with bizarre dreams and unconventional points of view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/31e00967f0b5d1f493f6313e92503dfb18a541f3.jpg[/img]
A tough mafia member, always accompanied by two bodyguards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/2420848e40c382cf25e5c9aa8fc8b16523dc60db.jpg[/img]
A son of rich parents, he always wears the latest fashion-brands clothes and loves speaking in catchphrases. As a rule, he also gesticulates way too much.
Surrounded by wealth and abundance since birth, C. Jee does not understand poor dinosaurs all too well. Many of his "friends" also simply use him as a convenient money bag.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/3520ba14452f22dba2bbe9649227339a85139a12.jpg[/img]
A shy girl who believes it is wrong to show bad emotions. She finds it easier to smile even when she is angry or feeling sad.

notes.title: Dinos vs. Robots Fest on Steam!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Dynopunk is participating in the Dinos vs. Robots Fest, held from February 26 to March 4. We're still looking through your feedback and bug reports on Steam and [url=https://discord.gg/MpJPKq4yyN]our Discord server.[/url] And here's another patch for you all, with a few more fixes for the issues you've reported.

notes.title: Updated Demo Version of Dynopunk at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[b]Tomato Fantasy Games[/b] studio is pleased to announce that the [b]Dynopunk [/b]demo received an update today as part of the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] event!

[b]Dynopunk [/b]is an ironic adventure with cyberpunk aesthetics, set in a world where humans have been replaced by dinosaurs. Become a top-notch repair shop mechanic: fix gadgets, have heart-to-heart talks and offer drinks to your customers — everything to fulfill your ultimate dream.

Introducing a new trailer that will showcase the world and the many individual character stories of [b]Dynopunk[/b] in greater detail!

[previewyoutube=jmmsLw0iAwQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The new title by [b]Tomato Fantasy Games[/b] indie studio will take you to an alternative world of the future where dinosaurs have settled the Earth instead of people and are now living in high-tech megalopolises.

The [b]Dynopunk[/b] demo offers a chance to live a full day as a resident of a futuristic city, but there is a catch — you will now have to deal with having much shorter arms!

Every dinosaur in the bustling [i]Synth-City[/i] has their own story, goals and dreams. It is his ultimate ambition that beckons Chris, the game's protagonist, toward neon metropolitan lights. While it may initially seem that he is really close to achieving his goal of acquiring a repair shop and becoming a first-class repair master, the best technician in town... 

But the moment you start playing, you will quickly realize that not everything is as it looks. Chris is the last living T. rex after all, so he dreams of building a time machine in order to go back to the past and find his true love. Whether he succeeds or not depends entirely on the [b]quality[/b] of your repair work and customer communication skills.

The demo features:
[list]
[*] One in-game day of running your own workshop where you can learn the secrets of equipment repairs. Disassemble and replace parts by carving out the required chips. You can even play a prank on your customers if you wish... or have an ulterior motive. Just be ready to face the consequences!
[*] Great opportunity to exchange pleasantries with a quirky assistant — a talking printer that enjoys teasing Chris about his little arms and likes to give questionable business advice.
[*] Drink serving simulator, which affects not only the customers' mood but also the size of your tip.
[*] Original, 80s-inspired Lo-fi soundtrack! Pour yourself a cup of hot tea, then sit back, relax and get immersed in the story.
[*] Many interesting characters that will pay a visit to your repair shop. Each of them comes with unique traits, dreams and a personal story that can be influenced by player choice.
[*] Dialogues full of irony, jokes, references and Easter eggs to cheer you up!
[*] Pixelated graphics inspired by 1990s retro gaming.
[/list]
See you in [b]Synth-City[/b]!

notes.title: Meet Dynopunk! A new game by Tomato Fantasy Games indie studio
notes.content:
Watch the new trailer for a sneak peek at the Dynopunk world, characters, and mechanics!

[previewyoutube=527sxZj5ZWs;full][/previewyoutube]

Imagine that a meteor never struck the Earth, the dinosaurs did not go extinct but continued to evolve. Millions of years later, they inhabit high-tech megapolises. One such dino is Chris, a repair shop owner, who dreams of building a Time Machine to travel to the past and find love, because he is the last T-Rex on the planet!

Dynopunk is an ironic adventure set in a cyberpunk world where dinosaurs have taken the place of humans. Run a repair shop, fix gadgets, find a personalized approach to every customer while offering them beverages and having heart-to-heart conversations. At the same time, you'll have to sort out your private life and chase your dream.
